title: GoofySMP
description: Modpack with all the mods that members of the goofysmp are using.
body:
This Modpack includes all the mods used by members of the goofysmp. It includes mods such as, simple voice chat, xaeros world/minimap, freecam, and many more... Many of these mods are not allowed on servers. I am not responsible if you get banned because of using any of these mods.
German Toutorial for Installing:
https://youtu.be/fo3GrWjd9Tg
